messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Bathroom ki deewar pe jo seepage tha, wo phir se aa gaya. Kal subah se paani tapak raha hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Wahi wala issue jo pichhle mahine fix hua tha? Ya koi naya spot hai? Photo bhej sakti ho?

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Wahi hai, usne sirf upar se paint kiya tha. Asli problem andar hai, isliye wo laut aaya.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Mishra ji ko likh ke bhejo, likhne me proof rehta hai. Phone pe baat karne se baad me mukar jaate hain.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Maine usko message bhej diya tha, dekha bhi nahi. Uski galti hai, kaam adhoora chhod diya.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Do din ka time do, phir likh ke bolo ki naye plumber ka kharcha wo dega. Warna deposit se kaat lena.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Wahan pe rehna mushkil ho gaya hai. Us cheez ki smell se sar dard karta hai, aur bacche bhi pareshan hain.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Sach me stressful hai. Ek temporary fix karwa lo, tape aur sealant se, aur usko bill bhej do.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Aaj Kaleem aayega, wo pehle bhi kaam karta tha. Usko wahi jagah dikhaungi jo seepage wali hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Achha, usko bolo ki andar ka plaster khol ke dekhe. Sirf bahar se seal karna kaam nahi karega.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Usne kaha ki teen hazaar lagega agar plaster kholna pada. Main soch rahi hoon ki ye kharcha kispe aayega.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Mishra ji pe. Unhone kharab fitting lagayi thi, jo teen mahine me hi leak ho gayi. Likho ki ye unki zimmedari hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Theek hai, main usko ye sab likh ke bhejti hoon. Wo mana kar sakta hai par likha hua kaam aayega.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Bilkul. Agar wo phir bhi na maane, to society ke group me daal do. Wahan sab dekh lenge.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Haan, aur main us cheez ki photo bhi rakh rahi hoon. Sab evidence save kar rahi hoon.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Sahi. Ab chain se so jao, subah Kaleem ko call kar lena.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Vikas ne bola ki wo humare saath Goa nahi ja raha. Uska boss leave nahi de raha.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Achha, to wo alag plan bana raha hai? Usko manane ki koshish karogi ya plan change karenge?

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Uski marzi hai. Doctor Nair ne bhi usko travel se mana kiya tha, BP high hai uski.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Ye important hai. Agar doctor ne mana kiya hai to usko rest karna chahiye, trip baad me ho sakti hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Par Sunita ma'am bhi keh rahi hain ki office me sab log chhutti le rahe hain, to usko guilt feel hota hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Office wale guilt ka pressure trip se zyada important nahi hai. Health pehle.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Haan. Aur landlord Batra uncle ne kaha ki building ka painting ka kaam usi hafte hoga, to ghar me shor rahega.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: To ghar me rehna bhi mushkil hai. Kya Vikas kisi cousin ke ghar ruk sakta hai us hafte?

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Wo keh raha hai ki usko akela rehna hai. Teacher wali behen, Meera, ne bhi kaha ki wo thoda low feel kar raha hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Meera ka observation sahi lagta hai. Usko call karke baat karo, zabardasti mat karo.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Main usko kal call karungi. Doctor Nair se report bhi mangwa rahi hoon.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Report aane pe decide karna. Abhi koi plan fix mat karo.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Theek hai. Sunita ma'am ko main message karti hoon ki wo leave de de.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Haan, par Vikas ki marzi poocho pehle. Uski life hai, uska decision hona chahiye.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Sahi kaha. Main usko batati hoon ki hum log samajhte hain.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Perfect. Chalo, tension kam karo. Sab theek ho jayega.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Mera parcel order SWX-4471-QP kahan hai? Tracking me teen din se same status hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Us number ko courier wali site pe daalo, wahan se live location milegi. Kya customer care ko call kiya?

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Haan, unka number 90000 12345 hai, par wo automated message pe le jaate hain.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Twitter pe tag karo, wahan insaan reply karta hai. Order id likh do saath me.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Achha. Waise delivery address galat chhap gaya tha, Flat 3B, Neel Kamal Apartments, Kalyani Nagar.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Agar address galat hai to parcel wapas jayega. Courier office jaake address correction form bharo.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Maine online form bhar diya tha, par unhone bola ki Rs 2,499 ka COD confirm karna padega.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: COD hai? To cash ready rakho. UPI wale driver bhi hote hain, par cash safe hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Haan, SWX-4471-QP 12 March ko aayega. Us din main ghar pe nahi hoon.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Kisi ko ghar pe rakho, warna driver wapas chala jayega. Ya courier office se pickup kar lo.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Mera bhai 12 March ko free hai, wo le lega. Usko OTP bhejna padega, order wale number pe aayega.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Haan, aur driver ko bhai ka naam bata dena. Gate pe koi dikkat na ho.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Haan wahi hai. Waise ek aur parcel aana hai, order GH-8802-LM, usme sirf ek book hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Wo alag shipment hai, uska tracking alag hoga. Dono ke liye alag alerts set karo.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Theek hai. Book wala 18 March ko aa raha hai, us din main office me hoon.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Book ka pickup bhi bhai se karwa lo. Ek hi trip me dono nikal jayenge.

questions.answer_quote: SWX-4471-QP 12 March ko aayega

questions.answer_quote: unka number 90000 12345 hai

questions.answer_quote: Courier office jaake address correction form bharo

questions.answer_quote: Book wala 18 March ko aa raha hai

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Bike phir se awaaz kar rahi hai. Pichhli baar chain ka problem tha, is baar kuch aur lagta hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Pehli service kis gaadi wale ne ki thi? Ravi Auto Works wala kaam theek tha ya nahi?

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Pehli baar January me Ravi Auto Works gaya tha, 1,150 rupaye liye the. Do hafte tak theek chali.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Do hafte me hi problem? To usne sirf chain tight ki hogi, adjust nahi kiya.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Ho sakta hai. Ab is baar March me Speed Motors ja rahi hoon, brake pads change karwane hain.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Brake pads ka kharcha alag hota hai. Kya unhone estimate diya?

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Haan, 2,300 rupaye bola. Front disc bhi thoda ghis gaya hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Disc ka kaam mehnga padta hai. Do jagah se quote lo, warna seedha paisa lag jayega.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Speed Motors wala bhaiya kehta hai ki disc abhi theek hai, sirf pads badal do.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: To sirf pads karwao. Disc baad me, jab zyada problem ho.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Haan. Waise pehli baar jo bill mila tha, wo maine kahin rakh diya tha.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Bill mil gaya to warranty claim ho sakta hai. Dhoondh lo, chain wala kaam usi ka tha.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Nahi mil raha. Lagta hai ghar shift karte waqt kho gaya.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Koi baat nahi. Ab Speed Motors ka bill sambhal ke rakho, wahi kaam aayega.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Theek hai. Aur ek baat, pehli baar mera phone bike pe hi reh gaya tha, wahan se wapas mila.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Achha, wo Ravi wala garage imaandar lagta hai. Is baar bhi check karke jao.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Aaj office me bahut bura din tha. Meeting me sabke saamne mujhe daant padi.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Yaar, ye sunke bura laga. Kya hua tha exactly?

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Mera project late ho gaya, aur Sunita ma'am ne bola ki main team ko update nahi de rahi.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Par tum to roz update bhejti ho. Ye unfair lagta hai, tumhari mehnat koi nahi dekh raha.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Bas wahi. Ghar aake roya bhi. Ab lagta hai ye job hi galat hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Ek bura din poora career decide nahi karta. Aaj rest karo, kal soch samajh ke baat karenge.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Aur ek problem hai. Kal night shift hai, par mere papa ki tabiyat kharab hai, unko doctor ke paas le jana hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: To shift swap karo kisi colleague se. Kis se swap ho sakta hai?

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Nikhil se ho sakta hai, wo raat wali shift pasand karta hai. Usko message kiya hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Achha. Aur papa ko subah le jao, doctor 10 baje se pehle free rehta hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Haan, appointment 10:30 baje ka hai. BP ki dawa bhi khatam ho gayi hai, refill karwana hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Dawa ki list bhejo, main pharmacy se le aaunga. Tum office sambhalo.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Thank you. Par mujhe lagta hai main sab kuch akeli handle kar rahi hoon, koi support nahi.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Main hoon na. Sunita ma'am ki baat kal bhool jaogi, par health wali cheez wait nahi karti.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Sahi. Nikhil ne haan bol diya, shift swap ho gaya. Ab kal raat free hoon.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Badhiya. Papa ko le jao, aur shaam ko apne liye kuch achha khana mangwa lo.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Haan. Aur kal Sunita ma'am se baat karke project update wala issue clear karungi.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Haan, shaant dimaag se. Aaj tumne bahut jhela hai, ab aaram karo.

questions.answer_quote: Sunita ma'am ne bola ki main team ko update nahi de rahi

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Nisha ki shaadi hai 15 May ko. Gift ke liye group bana hai, par sab log confused hain.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Kya gift decide hua ya abhi discussion me hai? Budget bhi batao.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Kavita ne bola ki hum sab milke ek washing machine dein. Usne price bhi nikaal liya.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Washing machine bada gift hai, ghar me jagah bhi chahiye. Nisha ke ghar me space hai kya?

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Wo nayi flat me shift ho rahi hai, wahan sab kuch chahiye. Par Vikas kehta hai cash dena better hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Dono ke point valid hain. Cash safe hai, par machine zyada yaad rehta hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Aur ek baat, Kavita ne kaha ki wo 8,000 rupaye de sakti hai, baaki hum baant lenge.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Total kitna ho raha hai? Machine ka price aur collection ka hisaab banao.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Machine 32,000 ki hai. Aath log hain, to har ek pe 4,000 aata hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Theek hai. Par Kavita ka 8,000 alag hai, to usko count karke baaki baant do.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Haan. Wo bol rahi hai ki wo delivery bhi arrange kar degi, uske bhai ka transport hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Achha, to delivery ka tension nahi. Bas payment ka hisaab group me daal do.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Vikas phir bhi cash pe adamant hai. Wo kehta hai ki machine duplicate ho sakti hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Uska matlab Nisha ke paas already machine ho sakti hai. Kavita se confirm karwao.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Sahi, main Kavita se poochhungi. Waise gift pe koi deadline hai kya shaadi se pehle?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Gift 15 May se pehle pahunchana chahiye. Order 10 May tak de dena.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Theek hai. Vikas ko bhi manana padega, warna wo alag gift le aayega.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Usko group me daalo, sabke saamne baat hui to wo zyada nahi bolega.
